content: JetBrains Mono: safe default, ligatures toggleable, true italics, wide multi-weight family, tuned for long-session code readability. Geist Mono: modern/designer pick, 7 weights, no ligatures, compressed proportions, pairs natively with Geist Sans. IBM Plex Mono: 8 weights, squared-off industrial terminals, pairs with IBM Plex Sans. All available self-hosted via Fontsource (@fontsource-variable scope, v5.3.0).
